answer: Enrollment takes a thirty-second wrist reading: the band signs a pulse signal and accelerometer data keyed to the epoch seed. A diastolic notch 180 to 260 ms after every systolic peak is what generators smooth away. Bands whose interval series mirror each other above 0.98 correlation count once, so one wrist cannot bankroll a crowd. Each band anchors one address and re-reads at seed-picked epochs, so a farm pays $70 a band and needs 1,000 people still at the same minute, near $70,000 before payout. A pulse check at the door is cheap for the traveller and fatal for the forger.
